summary_1line: Vipula, proud of his ascetic success, fetches celestial flowers but becomes disturbed when strangers invoke his supposed sinful fate during disputes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Celestial flowers fall from a heavenly nymph drifting through the sky, scattering fragrant blossoms near a forest hermitage.
Vipula pauses on a forest path holding glowing celestial flowers while a quarrelling couple nearby swears an oath invoking his fate.
Six excited gamblers with gold and silver dice argue fiercely, raising their hands as they swear an oath about Vipula’s doom.
